# tags off-default: extract_hashtags omitted (off) — #hashtags in the text are NOT
# extracted into tags; explicit --tag is the only source; tag rm has no text-anchor
# guard when off. (The opt-in ON path is covered by tags.txt.)
mkdir proj
cd proj
exec mtt init
stdout 'initialized'

# a #hashtag in the title is NOT extracted; only the explicit tag lands
exec mtt add --no-parent 'fix #login' --tag urgent
stdout 'created t1'
exec mtt show t1
stdout 'tags:     urgent'

# editing text to add a #hashtag changes no tags
exec mtt edit t1 --description 'see #backend'
exec mtt show t1
stdout 'tags:     urgent'

# tag rm has no text-anchor guard when off: a tag can be removed even though a
# matching #hashtag sits in the title (ON would refuse this)
exec mtt tag add t1 login
exec mtt tag rm t1 login
stdout 'untagged t1: login'
